title: Skateboard E-Gift — From Digital Code to Tangible Joy
jpTitle: スケートボードeギフト — コードから喜びへ

summary.en: Turned an impersonal skateboard e-gift-card redemption code into a full physical gifting experience: extracted 'life lessons' from skateboarding culture into a custom inspirational card set, then designed branded packaging engineering every layer of the unboxing for surprise. The entire brief was 'make my friend stoked.'
summary.jp: スケートボードのギフトカードの引換コードは、味気なかった。スケート文化にある教訓を抜き出し、人生訓のカード一式にした。開封の瞬間の驚きまで設計した、単独の案件。

mine: Extracted life lessons from skateboarding culture — persistence, reading the terrain, the joy of bailing and getting back up
Designed a set of custom inspirational cards reframing skating wisdom as life philosophy
Designed branded packaging, engineering every layer of the unboxing for maximum surprise
Took the project solo from concept through final delivery

label.en: digital gift code transformed into a tangible gift experience
label.jp: コードを贈り物の体験に一新

narrative.situation: A skateboard e-gift card — a perfectly fine present — but forwarding a redemption code felt impersonal.

_notes: Solo personal project, no client named; engagement recorded as unstated per the task's strict engagement rule rather than assumed own-venture.
